name: Antigravity
description: Gemini through your Antigravity subscription, served by Google's official Antigravity ACP server.

disclosure: Connect downloads Google's official Antigravity ACP server and signs in with your Google account in the browser; model calls use its Antigravity subscription.
Google's server keeps its own default instructions ahead of the instructions Octopus sends, and its built-in tools stay turned off.
